class.name: InputEventGaze
class.brief_description: Input event emitted when face and eye gaze tracking is actively locked.
class.description: Input event representing a real-time gaze tracking update. Dispatched when the user's face and eyes are actively tracked. Provides 2D gaze points projected onto viewport canvas space or localized to specific [CanvasItem] nodes via [method get_eye_gaze] and [method get_nose_gaze], as well as 3D spatial pose and gaze vectors.

method.name: is_face_tracked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] indicating active face tracking in this event.

method.name: get_eye_gaze
method.description: Returns the estimated 2D eye gaze position. If [param local_to] is [code]null[/code], the position is in canonical root Viewport Canvas space (pixels). If a [CanvasItem] (e.g. [Control] or [Node2D]) is passed, the position is transformed into that item's local coordinate space.

method.name: set_eye_gaze
method.description: Sets the 2D eye gaze position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates.

method.name: get_nose_gaze
method.description: Returns the estimated 2D nose gaze position (projection of the nose-forward vector onto the display surface). If [param local_to] is [code]null[/code], the position is in canonical root Viewport Canvas space (pixels). If a [CanvasItem] is passed, the position is transformed into that item's local coordinate space.

method.name: set_nose_gaze
method.description: Sets the 2D nose gaze position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates.

method.name: get_head_pose
method.description: Returns the 3D head pose in Godot camera space. The origin represents the 3D nose tip in millimeters relative to the camera; the basis represents the head orientation.

method.name: set_head_pose
method.description: Sets the 3D head pose in Godot camera space.

method.name: get_eye_origin
method.description: Returns the 3D eye gaze origin in Godot camera space (millimeters).

method.name: get_eye_direction
method.description: Returns the 3D normalized unit direction vector of the eye gaze in Godot camera space.

method.name: set_head_transform
method.description: Sets the underlying 3D head transform in Godot camera space.

method.name: get_head_transform
method.description: Returns the underlying 3D head transform in Godot camera space.

method.name: set_gaze_transform
method.description: Sets the underlying 3D gaze transform in Godot camera space.

method.name: get_gaze_transform
method.description: Returns the underlying 3D gaze transform in Godot camera space.

method.name: copy_from
method.description: Copies all event fields from another [InputEventGaze] instance.

method.name: as_text
method.description: Returns a formatted string representation of this gaze event.
